scope: Direct visual review of the twenty assigned immutable page images, including the entire D77 proof, the updated F7 overview, and the named historical overflow displays. This records actual visual inspection; it is not a new mathematical proof audit.

issues.description: Detached caron before Saric in the author name; current BibTeX author syntax is unbraced \v Sari\'c and generated bbl inserts \v~Sari\'c.
issues.recommended_source_fix: Brace the accented first letter as {\v S}ari\'c, then rebuild and visually inspect the corrected entry.
